eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Cognitive Informatics & Smart Computing (CISC) aims to provide a premier international platform for researchers, academicians, scientists, industry professionals, and practitioners to discuss and exchange innovative ideas, recent research findings, and technological advancements in the fields of cognitive informatics and smart computing. The conference focuses on emerging areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, data science, Internet of Things (IoT), cybersecurity, natural language processing, computer vision, robotics, cloud and edge computing, and intelligent automation systems. It also emphasizes interdisciplinary applications in healthcare, agriculture, smart cities, education, sustainability, and industrial systems. CISC encourages collaborative research, industry-academia interaction, and development of intelligent technologies for solving real-world societal and industrial challenges.
